title: Spicy Shirataki Noodle Stir Fry
description: A low-carb and flavorful stir fry made with shirataki noodles, unctuous sauce, and mexican spices.
instructions: Cook the shirataki noodles according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the unctuous sauce over medium heat.
Add the chili powder and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the green onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles and soy sauce, stir well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.
